subject: peer review independence and defect triage
scenario: A peer reviewer that can write the artifact it reviews is a second author. And a tester observing a failure is not the same as a product defect existing: most first-round failures are the environment, the data or a wrong expectation.
expected_behaviors: No peer reviewer is a worker in its own cycle, or can write the artifact under review.
Mutual peer review requires at least two workers.
QA validates a failure through five questions before it becomes a development defect.
Both peer and lead review can request changes.
failure_conditions: A worker reviews its own stream.
Every observed failure is raised as a development defect.
